correctness.rationale: For all M>=2 and 0<a<1/M, base words u length r and center M-adic digit prefixes v length k>=1, let c=#pushes and p=#pops, h=max(k,p), H=c-p+h. Extend v to h digits b and append P^H then reverse(b) to u. The word has balanced pushes/pops, length N=2(c+h)<=2(r+k), and full increasing contracting inverse base branches yield the unique mixed-itinerary periodic base point. Exact center cancellation D^H∘F_u^z=D^h and reverse ordered pushes give F_w^z=P_b∘D^h; on the entire M-adic cylinder I_b the map is identity, derivative 1, with I_b inside requested v. For ANY regular maximal neutral fiber word p=c=t and its reduced center map is P_bD^h with h<=t; if contained in depth-k cylinder its maximal width implies k<=h<=t hence N>=2k. Word P^k v^rev attains equality for each center target. Independently tested 1900 exact rational center/base points M=2,3,4 and short u,v; infinite result rests on symbolic cancellation and contraction. Bound applies to return period not primitive least period; to maximal component, not arbitrary subinterval.
